visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image and text rows with eyebrow, heading, copy and pill CTA; image side follows cell order
notes: Page cream background #f9f7f2. Three alternating image/text rows (image left, then right, then left); small gold uppercase eyebrow, uppercase spaced h2, body copy, dark pill button.
Dark #1d1f22 band; text left (gold eyebrow, white uppercase h2, 2 paragraphs, white pill button with arrow), large aerial image bleeding to the right edge.

contentPattern.structure: one row per media/text pair; one cell = image, other cell = eyebrow paragraph + h2 + paragraph(s) + CTA link; put the image first or last to choose its side
patterns: single row text left, image bleeding right
blockContent: 3 rows: Progress at NEOM (YouTube link), Our commitment to nature, NEOM Sports Club; each = image + eyebrow + h2 + paragraph + CTA
Text column (eyebrow "Port of NEOM", h2 "Open for business", 2 paragraphs, Learn more) beside port aerial image

usage.description: Feature rows alternating image left/right, or a single text + image row in a dark section.

reuseGuidance: Use for media/text splits with an eyebrow. Use columns for generic multi-column layouts.
